claim_text: On May 20, 2026, prosecutors filed a two-count Information against Fahima Egeh Mahamud in United States v. Mahamud, No. 0:26-cr-00097-JWB (Doc. 26). Count 1 charges wire fraud, 18 U.S.C. §§ 1343 and 2, based on an alleged June 15, 2021 email to Feeding Our Future in furtherance of the Federal Child Nutrition Program scheme. Count 2 charges conspiracy to defraud the United States, 18 U.S.C. § 371, based on the separate Child Care Assistance Program scheme. These are charging allegations, not adjudicated facts and not proof of a later guilty plea.

supporting_passages.quote: Count 2 (Conspiracy to Defraud the United States)

qualifiers: Count 1 concerns Federal Child Nutrition Program / Feeding Our Future conduct; Count 2 concerns separate CCAP conduct
This charging instrument does not establish Mahamud's later plea status or her ordinal in scheme-wide conviction counts
